name: DhirDhar v3.5.1
changelog:
DhirDhar v3.5.1 Release Notes:

### Outsource & Capital Improvements
- Capital Details Date Synchronization: Unified Capital Date and Interest Date into a single intuitive date picker. Selected Capital Date automatically synchronizes and persists as the Interest Date for seamless interest calculation.
- Table Layout & Action Button Visibility: Resolved Action column clipping on the Outsource Added Borrowers table. Edit and Delete action buttons are fully visible and accessible within table boundaries.

### Core Stability & Verification
- Enterprise Hardened Production Installer: Packaged as a single self-contained installer (DhirDhar-3.5.1-x64-Setup.exe) with LZMA2 ultra-compression.
- Strict Financial & Engine Integrity: Zero modifications to core calculation logic, interest engine, and transaction processing.
- 1,707 Automated Tests Passing: Full test suite verified with 100% pass rate across Domain, Application, and Infrastructure layers.
